item.title: Elon Musk Fails to Dismiss SEC Case Alleging Delay in Reporting Twitter Shares
item.description: A federal judge rejects Elon Musk's bid to dismiss the SEC lawsuit over delayed Twitter share disclosures.

item.title: Disney Succession Drama Heats Up as Nelson Peltz Targets Bob Iger
item.description: Nelson Peltz reignites his feud with Bob Iger, accusing Disney's CEO of manipulating the succession plan.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Release Date: July 2026 Launch Expected with Major Upgrades & Wider Variant
item.description: Samsung Electronics Co. is gearing up for what could be its most ambitious foldable year yet, with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 slated for an official unveiling in July 2026 during the company's summer Galaxy Unpacked event, according to multiple leaks, industry reports and supply chain filings.

item.title: At Least 15 Dead in Collision Between Migrant Speedboat and Greek Coast Guard Vessel Off Chios
item.description: At least 15 migrants died after a high-speed speedboat carrying them collided with a Greek Coast Guard patrol vessel off the eastern Aegean island of Chios late Tuesday, authorities said Wednesday, in a rare direct vessel-to-vessel incident amid ongoing Mediterranean migration pressures.

item.title: (VIDEO) 13-Year-Old Boy Swims 4km Through Rough Seas to Save Family Stranded Off Western Australia
item.description: A 13-year-old boy has been hailed a hero after swimming approximately 4 kilometers (2.5 miles) through choppy, shark-frequented waters for four hours to raise the alarm when his mother and two younger siblings were swept out to sea off Geographe Bay, authorities and family members said.

item.title: 'Angel Meloni' Scrubbed from Rome Church Painting on Priest's Orders After Political Uproar
item.description: A restored angel fresco bearing a striking resemblance to Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni was painted over and effectively "scrubbed" from a historic church wall on the orders of the parish priest, following days of political controversy, clerical dismay and public curiosity that drew crowds to the Basilica of St. Lawrence in Lucina.

item.title: 9-Year-Old Boy Suffers Severe Facial Burns After Attempting Dangerous TikTok Trend with Microwaved Toy
item.description: A 9-year-old boy from suburban Chicago is recovering from second-degree burns to his face and hands after microwaving a popular gel-filled sensory toy in a viral social media trend that has sent multiple children to hospitals, his mother and medical officials said Wednesday.

item.title: Alphabet, Google's Parent Company, Exceeds US$400 Billion in Annual Revenue for the First Time
item.description: Alphabet, Google's parent company, also reported that its Q4 2025 revenue reached US$113.8 billion.

item.title: Teens Say Social Media Ban Isn't Effective as Spain Follows Australia's Footsteps
item.description: Teens interviewed by ABC News say that the social media ban is not effective just as Spain announced it will follow in Australia's footsteps.

item.title: Gus Lamont: SA Police Declares His Disappearance a Major Crime
item.description: South Australia police have declared the disappearance of Gus Lamont a major crime, saying that a suspect has been identified.
